footer.tagline: A working guest shop with inventory and order operations.

sections.title: Three offers to replace with the real catalog
sections.body: Edit this seed locally, restock through Staff MCP, then run the complete guest checkout.

items.title: {{BRAND}} Starter
items.body: A simple entry offer. USD 29.00; replace this copy and price with a real product.

items.title: {{BRAND}} Plus
items.body: A broader option for customers who need more. USD 59.00 with the included demo checkout.

items.title: {{BRAND}} Complete
items.body: The highest starter tier for comparing demand. USD 99.00 with tracked stock and orders.

sections.title: Run the full guest-order lifecycle
sections.body: Cart, fake payment, real orders, atomic inventory, expiry Queue, and recovery Cron are included; customer accounts and real payment credentials are not.

items.title: Shape the offer
items.body: Replace the seed products and homepage cards with the first real catalog.

items.title: Restock and operate
items.body: Use Staff MCP to inspect, restock, adjust, fulfill, or cancel orders.

items.title: Replace fake payment later
items.body: Swap the demo payment action for a real provider only when the business is ready.

items.title: Can I edit this without GitHub OAuth?
items.body: Yes. Edit this seed for the local first page; Staff MCP becomes the authoring path after auth is configured.

items.title: Is checkout already enabled?
items.body: Yes. It creates a real operational order and changes stock, while the payment screen is explicitly simulated.

items.title: Where does the product model live?
items.body: The products and product-translations Schemas live in manifests/site.yaml.
